# External Reference Assets

Unused third-party packs are intentionally excluded from the runtime Godot
project. Their creators, licenses, and canonical download pages are recorded in
[`assets/THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md`](../THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md).

The local development archive was moved to the sibling folder
`WoW Battleheart Reference Assets`. Copy only selected, production-ready files
back into `assets/` when the game actually uses them, and preserve the relevant
license record.
